description: Attachment slot definitions for 3D-rendered chibi base. Cell size 256x256. Slots are LARGER than the model to accommodate hair volume, hats, etc. Coordinates are for FRONT (S) view, neutral pose.
note: Head center approx (128, 95), head radius ~20px. Slots use generous bounds.

eyes.description: Eye region on face. For front view only.

hair.description: Hair region. 2.75x head width, extends above head for volume.

hat.description: Hat region. Larger than hair, sits on top of head.
